newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-AUSTRALIA BEAT HUNGARY 3-1 IN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRALIA BEAT HUNGARY 3-1 IN FRIENDLY.

text.p: The presence of legendary fifties Hungarian footballer Ferenc Puskas as guest of honour could not inspire Hungary to overcome Terry Venables' Australia in a friendly international in Budapest on Wednesday.

Australia took the lead as early as the fifth minute through a simple headed goal by Aurelio Vidmar, but Hungary countered through Laszlo Klausz, who broke through the strong Australian defence in the 31st minute for a fine individual strike.

Second half pressure by Hungary failed to find a breakthrough and just as the match appeared to be ending in an honourable draw, goals in the final minute by Muscat and a second by Vidmar took the wind out of celebrations marking Puskas's 70th birthday.
